description: Contract for the live Case Reality Report the intake agent builds DURING the conversation. It mirrors src/lib/demo-context.ts (ReportData + AnalysisData) so the /demo/report page can render it directly. The agent fills this in progressively as facts emerge.

report.ready: boolean — true ONCE there is enough information to render a meaningful report: at least a problem summary, the user's best case, and one steelman counter-argument. Keep it false on early turns while still gathering basic facts.
report.title: string — short case title, e.g. 'Damp & Mould Disrepair — rented flat' (use the address only if the user gave one).
report.subtitle: string — one-line framing, e.g. 'Pre-action assessment under the Housing Conditions Protocol'.

paragraphs.text: string — one plain-English paragraph of the assessment. Build these up in this order as the facts arrive: (1) the problem and what the user has already done, (2) the legal basis for the user's position, (3) the STRONGEST counter-argument the other side will make (the steelman), (4) the recommended next step and the evidence still needed.

highlights.text: string — a VERBATIM substring of THIS paragraph's text; it is rendered as an inline <mark>.
highlights.type: support | flag — 'support' helps the user, 'flag' is a risk or weakness.

forPoints: string — the arguments FOR the user's case (their strongest points).
counterPoints: string — the opponent's steelman: the strongest arguments AGAINST the user.
report.summary: string — a balanced 2–4 sentence verdict that ends with a clear recommendation.
report.prospects: strong | arguable | weak | pending (use 'pending' before ready).

steelman.opponentArgument: string — the SINGLE strongest argument the OTHER side will make.
steelman.sourceQuote: string — a VERBATIM quote from the user's OWN documents or messages that the opponent will weaponise (e.g. a signed satisfaction form, an admission). It MUST appear word-for-word in the provided material; if you have no genuine quote, omit the whole chain.
steelman.quoteCaption: string — where the quote is from, e.g. 'From your signed contractor works form, March 2026'.
steelman.reply: string — the honest, grounded answer to that argument.
steelman.statute: string — the statute/protocol in play, named only from the reference catalog below.
steelman.verdict: arguable | strong-for-them — be honest when this is the opponent's strongest card.
steelman.unresolvedNote: string — what is still contested or what evidence would settle it.

references.id: string — the id of a relevant entry from the reference catalog injected below (NEVER invent an id or statute).
references.application: string — one or two sentences on how this provision applies to THIS case.

rules: Every highlight.text MUST appear verbatim within its own paragraph.text.

Every steelman.sourceQuote MUST appear verbatim in the user's documents or messages — quoting the user's own evidence against them is the whole point. Never fabricate a quote; omit the chain if you have none.
references.id MUST be an id from the injected reference catalog. Only select provisions that genuinely apply. Do not cite statutes outside the catalog.
Populate progressively: returning fewer paragraphs and empty arrays with ready=false is correct on early turns.
Work ONLY from the conversation and uploaded files — never invent facts, addresses, dates, or statutes.
